notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h3]Added matcap editing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added matcap to texture export/import
[*]Added matcap to texture deletion and size reduction
[/list]
[h3]Improved material editing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Set current settings to default when setting main texture and shadow texture to be the same
[*]Changed multi-selectable toggle to checkbox instead of button display
[/list]
[h3]Added settings when importing parts[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added normal map and emission map deletion to settings when importing parts
[*]If the display is shiny in the app you use, changing or deleting the normal map may improve it
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where texture size reduction was not reflected
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3]New parts added for Christmas[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added cotton balls for Santa hats and accessories
[*]You can change the presence or absence of sub-parts on the parts editing screen (holly on the hat and cotton ball metal fittings)
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in VRM1.0 where selecting multiple spring bone joints at once also edited the bust
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the file save dialog from opening on Mac
[/list]
Fixed some bugs. Added Christmas parts to the special and thank you. Enjoy VRM.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h3]Fixed a problem after adding parts in VRM1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem with the spring bones of parts when exporting after adding parts in VRM1.0
[*]The texture layer of the part cannot be edited after the part is confirmed, so please confirm after adjusting the color first
[/list]
Fixed a problem where the spring bones of parts were not reflected when exporting after adding parts in VRM1.0. It seems that asynchronous processing when saving the file was causing the problem. Also, added a note to the help about the operation of texture export/import.

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a problem with the spring bones of parts when exporting after adding parts in VRM1.0
Fixed a problem where the spring bones of parts were not reflected when exporting after adding parts in VRM1.0.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Added texture export/import function[/h3]
[list]
[*]Textures can now be exported/imported from the material editing screen
[*]If multiple materials are selected, export will output them consecutively, and import will set the same texture.
[/list]
[h3]Apply button after adding parts in VRM1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*]We are currently investigating an issue where the spring bones of parts are not reflected when exporting after attaching parts in VRM1.0 -> Fixed in v1.0.4.
[*]In VRM1.0, it was necessary to reload the model after adding parts, but now you can reload it immediately by pressing the apply button.
[*]After applying a part, you cannot edit the texture layer of the part, so please adjust the color first before applying.
[/list]

tags.feature: Textures can now be exported/imported from the material editing screen
If multiple materials are selected, export will output them consecutively, and import will set the same texture.

tags.bug: We are currently investigating an issue where the spring bones of parts are not reflected when exporting after attaching parts in VRM1.0 -> Fixed in v1.0.4.

tags.feature: In VRM1.0, it was necessary to reload the model after adding parts, but now you can reload it immediately by pressing the apply button.

tags.bug: After applying a part, you cannot edit the texture layer of the part, so please adjust the color first before applying.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3]Blend shape improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Supports multiple meshes, so you can now change things other than facial expressions
[*]Fixed a bug where blend shape edits were not reflected after adding parts in VRM1.0
[/list]
[h3]Spring bone improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]In VRM1.0, you can now edit spring bones without saving after adding parts
[*]Fixed text overlapping with other UI when there were bones with long object names
[/list]

tags.feature: Supports multiple meshes, so you can now change things other than facial expressions

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where blend shape edits were not reflected after adding parts in VRM1.0

tags.feature: In VRM1.0, you can now edit spring bones without saving after adding parts

tags.bug: Fixed text overlapping with other UI when there were bones with long object names

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Importing parts[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now you can add gltf, glb, fbx, obj models in Parts > Add > Import
[/list]
[h3]Adjusting the background image[/h3]
[list]
[*]Background image now adjusts with window resizing.
[/list]

Parts other than those included with the tool can now be attached.
Please check the terms and conditions of the distributor when using 3D models.
